# TODAY
> NBC's TODAY Show site for news, interviews, videos, lifestyle advice, shopping coverage, and show information.

TODAY.com publishes daily reporting, celebrity and guest interviews, wellness and parenting advice, recipes, shopping recommendations, and video from NBC's TODAY franchise, including its weekday and weekend programs.

## Main Sections
- [On the Show](https://www.today.com/on-the-show): Hub for guests, segments, features, and highlights appearing on TODAY.
- [Show Video](https://www.today.com/video): Video library for interviews, clips, features, and full TODAY segments.
- [About TODAY](https://www.today.com/about/today/about-today-nbc-rcna150631): Overview of the show, anchors, editorial information, and contact details.
- [Podcasts](https://www.today.com/podcasts): Collection of TODAY audio programs and podcast-related content.
- [Shop](https://www.today.com/shop): Editorial shopping coverage, product picks, deals, and buying guides.
- [Flashback Video](https://www.today.com/flashback-video): Archive-style video collection revisiting memorable TODAY moments.

## Shows
- [3rd Hour of TODAY](https://www.today.com/3rd-hour-today): Coverage and segments from the 3rd Hour of TODAY.
- [Jenna & Sheinelle](https://www.today.com/jenna-and-sheinelle): Show page for Jenna & Sheinelle segments, guests, and features.
- [Saturday TODAY](https://www.today.com/saturday-today): Weekend show page with Saturday TODAY stories and video.
- [Sunday TODAY](https://www.today.com/sunday-today): Sunday TODAY coverage, interviews, commentary, and featured segments.
- [TODAY Homepage](https://www.today.com): Main entry point for the latest TODAY stories, videos, and features.

## Shopping
- [Shop TODAY](https://www.today.com/shop): Main shopping hub with product recommendations, reviews, and seasonal coverage.
- [Shop the Show](https://www.today.com/shop/on-the-show): Products and items featured on TODAY segments and broadcasts.
- [Spring Savings](https://www.today.com/shop/deals): Deals hub for seasonal sales, discounts, and limited-time offers.
- [Big Spring Sale](https://www.today.com/shop/amazon-big-spring-sale-deals-2026-rcna264472): Coverage of Amazon's Big Spring Sale and featured deal picks.
- [Wallet Watch](https://www.today.com/shop/wallet-watch): Budget-focused shopping advice and value-minded product coverage.
- [Shop TODAY Savings](https://www.today.com/shop/shop-today-savings-coupons): Coupon and savings page for retailer discounts and promo offers.
- [Ranked by Shop TODAY](https://www.today.com/shop/ranked): Ranked product lists and editorially ordered recommendations.
- [Steals & Deals](https://deals.today.com/): Dedicated deals site for limited-time offers featured by TODAY.

- [About TODAY](https://www.today.com/about/today/about-today-nbc-rcna150631): Background on the program, hosts, and official show information.

## About & Editorial Information
- [About TODAY](https://www.today.com/about/today/about-today-nbc-rcna150631): Official about page with team, show background, and policy information.
- [TODAY Homepage](https://www.today.com): Front page for the latest editorial coverage across all TODAY topics.
- [On the Show](https://www.today.com/on-the-show): Editorially curated listing of current show content and appearances.

## Featured Commerce Topics
- [Shop the Show](https://www.today.com/shop/on-the-show): Direct access to products highlighted during TODAY broadcasts.
- [Spring Savings](https://www.today.com/shop/deals): Seasonal savings coverage across major retailers and categories.
- [Wallet Watch](https://www.today.com/shop/wallet-watch): Practical shopping advice centered on affordability and smart spending.
- [Ranked by Shop TODAY](https://www.today.com/shop/ranked): Best-of lists organized by category and editorial ranking.
- [Shop TODAY Savings](https://www.today.com/shop/shop-today-savings-coupons): Savings-focused page collecting coupons and retailer promotions.
- [Steals & Deals](https://deals.today.com/): External TODAY deals portal with featured brand promotions and discounts.
